description: Source code implementing modular inverse functions for big numbers in BoringSSL's FIPS module, including algorithms for odd modulus and prime modulus cases.

methods.name: BN_mod_inverse
methods.description: Computes modular inverse of a number modulo n, handling odd and even moduli.

methods.name: BN_mod_inverse_odd
methods.description: Computes modular inverse when modulus is odd using binary inversion algorithm.

methods.name: BN_mod_inverse_blinded
methods.description: Performs blinded modular inverse to protect against side-channel attacks.

methods.name: bn_mod_inverse_prime
methods.description: Computes modular inverse for prime modulus using BN_mod_exp_mont.

methods.name: bn_mod_inverse_secret_prime
methods.description: Computes modular inverse for prime modulus using constant-time exponentiation.
